- serde = { version='1', features=['derive'] }
- serde_json = '1'
- thiserror = '1'

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
1. Add [dependencies] ropey, serde, serde_json, thiserror to src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml (the handshake-native crate).
2. Define NodeKind enum (block variants) and Mark enum (inline mark variants) in node.rs. BlockNode { kind: NodeKind, attrs: HashMap<String,serde_json::Value>, children: Vec<Child> } where Child = Block(BlockNode) | Text(TextLeaf). TextLeaf { rope: Rope, marks: Vec<Mark> }.
3. In schema.rs, define ALLOWED_MARKS_PER_NODE as a static map; implement fn validate_node(node: &BlockNode, schema: &Schema) -> Result<(), SchemaError> checked on every transaction apply.
4. In transform.rs, Step enum covers insert/delete text (char range into a TextLeaf's Rope), insert/delete nodes (by path), split/merge nodes, add/remove mark over char range. Transaction is Vec<Step> + metadata (actor_kind, actor_id). apply_transaction clones the doc, applies each step in order, runs schema validation; on error rolls back and returns Err. TransactionReceipt carries the inverse steps for undo.
5. In history.rs, UndoManager stores a VecDeque<TransactionReceipt> capped at 200; undo re-applies the inverse steps; redo re-applies the forward steps.
6. In position.rs, DocPosition is a path Vec<usize> (child indices through the tree) + char_offset: usize. resolve(doc, abs) walks the tree accumulating char lengths.
7. In doc_json.rs, implement serde Serialize/Deserialize that maps to the Tiptap JSONContent shape: {type:'doc', content:[{type:'paragraph',content:[{type:'text',text:'...',marks:[{type:'bold'}]}]}]}. The schema_version field must equal 'rich_document_v1' (same as WP009_RICH_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION in the React reference).
8. Wire src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/mod.rs to pub mod document_model, and register pub mod rich_editor in src/frontend/handshake_native/src/lib.rs.
9. Write a flat cargo integration test src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/test_document_model.rs (or inline #[cfg(test)]) covering: insert text, delete text, undo/redo round-trip, add/remove mark, insert/delete block node, split paragraph, merge paragraphs, DocJson serialize then deserialize equals original doc.

original_scope.summary:
Implement WYSIWYG rendering of the MT-011 block document model onto the egui canvas, using cosmic-text for glyph layout/shaping and winit IME events for multi-language text input. This MT delivers the core visible editing surface: a scrollable egui widget that renders the document tree as a sequence of styled paragraphs/blocks, positions a blinking text caret, accepts keyboard and IME composition input, and issues Transactions back to the MT-011 model.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: create src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/ containing: mod.rs, line_layout.rs (cosmic-text Buffer/FontSystem management; shapes each TextLeaf's rope content with mark-derived font attributes into cosmic_text::LayoutLine items), block_renderer.rs (egui Painter calls per BlockNode kind: paragraph renders shaped lines, heading renders with scale factor, blockquote adds a left bar + tint, code_block renders monospace in a rounded rect, list items add bullets/numbers, table renders a grid), caret.rs (DocCaret: tracks Selection from MT-011, blinks at 500 ms via egui's ctx.request_repaint_after, paints a 2 px egui Painter rect at the correct pixel position resolved from cosmic-text glyph positions), ime_handler.rs (converts winit::event::Ime::Commit and Ime::Preedit into InsertText/DeleteText Transactions; preedit shown as underlined inline text), input_handler.rs (converts egui keyboard events: printable chars -> InsertText, Backspace -> DeleteText, Delete -> DeleteText forward, ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down -> selection moves, Home/End -> line/doc boundary moves, Shift+arrow -> extend selection, Ctrl+A -> select all), and rich_editor_widget.rs (the top-level egui::Widget impl: owns FontSystem + DocModel + UndoManager; update() calls block_renderer, caret, input_handler in sequence; scrolling via egui ScrollArea).

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
1. In line_layout.rs, create FontSystemHolder (cosmic_text::FontSystem wrapped in a RefCell for single-threaded egui access). For each TextLeaf in a paragraph, create a cosmic_text::Attrs based on the leaf's marks (bold -> Weight::BOLD, italic -> Style::Italic, code -> family Monospace) and call Buffer::set_text. Store the resulting LayoutLine items with their pixel widths for hit-testing.
2. In block_renderer.rs, iterate the document tree. For each BlockNode: call line_layout to get shaped lines; use egui Painter::galley_with_override_text_style or raw painter.text() with the cosmic-text pixel positions. Heading: multiply font size by [1.8, 1.5, 1.25] for h1/h2/h3. Blockquote: paint a 3 px left bar in accent color, indent 16 px. code_block: use egui::Frame with rounded corners and the code background color; monospace font. list items: paint '•' or '1.' prefix. table: compute column widths, paint cell borders with painter.rect_stroke.
3. In caret.rs, after block_renderer lays out all lines, resolve the cursor DocPosition to a pixel (x, y) by summing line heights to the cursor paragraph, then scanning glyph advances within the line. Paint a 2 px wide rect of the theme's text color. Blink: toggle a bool on egui timer (ctx.input(|i| i.time) modulo 1.0 > 0.5). Call ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(250)) to drive blinks.
4. In ime_handler.rs, on winit::event::Ime::Preedit(text, cursor_range): replace the preedit region with an underlined InlineText span (use a dedicated PreeditMark); on Ime::Commit(text): finalize with InsertText transaction. Integrate with the egui-winit bridge's event loop. winit IME must be enabled via window.set_ime_allowed(true) in the shell init (document this as a shell contract requirement).
5. In input_handler.rs, handle egui Key events (egui::Key::Backspace, Delete, ArrowLeft, etc.) and egui::Event::Text for printable characters. Map to Transactions and feed to UndoManager. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z -> undo/redo via UndoManager. All key handling must respect egui's consume_key pattern to avoid double-handling.
6. In rich_editor_widget.rs, impl egui::Widget for RichEditorWidget { fn ui(self, ui: &mut egui::Ui) -> egui::Response }. The widget owns a RichEditorState (DocModel + UndoManager + FontSystemHolder + scroll offset). ScrollArea::vertical wraps the block_renderer output.
7. AccessKit: REUSE the existing WP-011 accessibility layer (src/frontend/handshake_native/src/accessibility/mod.rs + registry.rs + live.rs + snapshot.rs) to assign a stable AccessKit NodeId (author_id = 'rich-editor-root') with Role::TextInput to the top-level widget. Each paragraph block gets author_id = format!('re-block-{}', path_hash) with Role::Paragraph. The caret position is reported as AccessKit::TextPosition so screen readers and swarm agents can locate it. Register nodes through the accessibility/registry.rs API rather than calling egui::Context::set_accesskit_node directly.

implementation_notes: cosmic-text FontSystem must be created once and reused across frames (wrap in egui UserData or a long-lived state struct); recreating it each frame causes visible font flicker.
cosmic-text uses pixel coordinates; egui uses logical points. Convert: pixel = point * egui_ctx.pixels_per_point(). Apply this conversion before all painter calls.

winit IME integration requires the egui-winit EventLoop to forward Ime events to the widget; check that the WP-011 shell's event loop (src/frontend/handshake_native/src/main.rs + app.rs, delivered by WP-011) forwards WindowEvent::Ime variants. This is a cross-WP dependency on WP-011's shell wiring, not a same-WP MT dependency.
The caret blink timer must use egui's time (ctx.input(|i| i.time)), not std::time::Instant, to avoid fighting egui's repaint scheduling.
For the vertical-slice proof, implement paragraph + bold/italic + heading + caret first; add table/list/blockquote/code_block in subsequent passes within this MT.

AccessKit NodeIds must use AccessKit's NodeId::new(u64) seeded from a deterministic hash of the block path, not a random ID, so swarm agents can reference them by stable value across repaints; register and resolve these through the existing src/frontend/handshake_native/src/accessibility/registry.rs API.
egui_kittest: use egui_kittest::Harness::new_ui(|ui| { widget.ui(ui); }) for all automated rendering tests; do not rely on manual visual inspection as the only proof.

RENDERING ENGINE RECONCILIATION (KERNEL_BUILDER gate 2026-06-22 + research wf_ffa74d6d - this is the research's #1 hardest gap): PREFER egui LayoutJob + epaint Galley as the rendering+caret engine over cosmic-text. A LayoutJob renders multi-run styled text (bold/italic/code/color/size per section) in ONE galley, and Galley::pos_from_cursor / cursor_from_pos give NATIVE caret pixel hit-testing - this de-risks the hardest gap (no hand-rolled glyph-advance caret, no manual pixel/point conversion). The widget renders each MT-011 block as a styled Galley + paints a custom caret resolved via the galley + feeds egui input events to MT-011 Transactions. This is NOT egui TextEdit (uniform-style, can't do mid-paragraph marks) and NOT a giant TextEdit; it is the research's Ferrite/LayoutJob pattern. Use cosmic-text ONLY if the mandatory vertical-slice spike proves egui LayoutJob insufficient for a REQUIRED feature (e.g. a complex script) - justify in that case. ITALIC NOTE: egui does NOT synthesize italic; WP-011 bundles Inter-Regular + Inter-Bold but likely NOT italic, so bundle Inter-Italic (+ BoldItalic) into the crate assets/fonts dir and register named font families for the italic/bold-italic LayoutJob sections (bold already works via Inter-Bold).

IME VIA egui::Event::Ime, NOT winit (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): do NOT add winit as a direct dep and do NOT handle raw winit::event::Ime - that fights eframe's event loop. egui already surfaces winit IME through the egui-winit bridge as egui::Event::Ime { Enable | Preedit(text,cursor) | Commit(text) | Disable }; read those from ui.input(). The shell enables IME via the eframe/egui-winit setup (set_ime_allowed) - document it as a shell contract but consume egui::Event::Ime, not winit. IME double-insert guard (RISK): clear the preedit region BEFORE applying Commit; one test simulates Preedit then Commit and asserts the rope holds only the committed text.

VERTICAL-SLICE-FIRST (research #1 risk + contract): ship paragraph + bold/italic marks + heading scale + custom caret + ASCII typing + the AC-1 'Hello world (bold world)' kittest SCREENSHOT FIRST and prove it, THEN extend to lists/tables/blockquote/code_block in the same MT. egui_commonmark READING-MODE is a SEPARATE later MT (MT-055), NOT here - MT-012 is the edit-mode WYSIWYG view only.

RISKS/CONTROLS: (a) caret blink ctx.request_repaint_after MUST be guarded by response.has_focus() so an unfocused editor does NOT burn idle CPU (test it). (b) empty TextLeaf / empty block: special-case so layout never panics on a 0-length rope. (c) AccessKit NodeId from a STABLE hash of the block path (deterministic, not random); test a 500-paragraph doc for ZERO id collisions; reuse the WP-011 accessibility/registry.rs API. (d) caret/selection positions MUST be validated against doc bounds at the INPUT layer (the MT-011 RopeText clamp decision carried forward: do not rely on the rope's silent clamp to mask an off-by-one caret bug - clamp/validate at the caret layer and assert). (e) accesskit variant: use the field-correct nearest accesskit 0.21.1 Role if TextInput/Paragraph differ; ACs assert author_id.

original_scope.summary:
Implement the full set of block-level formatting commands and the editor toolbar, achieving parity with the Tiptap toolbar implemented in the React reference at app/src/components/RichTextEditor.tsx (MT-169) and app/src/lib/editor/editor_commands.ts. This MT delivers: (1) a FormattingCommands module with typed Rust functions for every formatting action, (2) a toolbar egui widget row with buttons for every command, (3) keyboard shortcuts wired to the same commands.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/formatting/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/formatting/commands.rs (all formatting command fns)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/formatting/toolbar.rs (egui toolbar widget)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/formatting/keymap.rs (keyboard shortcut bindings)
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/rich_editor_widget.rs to host the toolbar above the content area.

FORMATTING COMMANDS to implement (must match React catalog in editor_commands.ts categories 'format', 'block', 'list', 'table', 'tableEdit'):
  INLINE MARKS: toggle_bold, toggle_italic, toggle_underline, toggle_strike, toggle_code.
  BLOCK TYPES: set_paragraph, set_heading(level: u8 [1-3]), set_blockquote, set_code_block(language: Option<String>), insert_horizontal_rule.
  LISTS: toggle_bullet_list, toggle_ordered_list, toggle_task_list, sink_list_item (indent), lift_list_item (dedent).
  TABLE: insert_table(rows: u8, cols: u8), add_row_before, add_row_after, delete_row, add_col_before, add_col_after, delete_col, delete_table, toggle_header_row.
  HISTORY: undo (delegate to MT-011 UndoManager), redo.

Each command function signature: fn command_name(doc: &mut DocModel, history: &mut UndoManager, selection: &Selection) -> Result<(), CommandError>. Internally it builds a Transaction, calls apply_transaction, pushes to UndoManager on success.

TOOLBAR WIDGET (toolbar.rs):
- Single horizontal egui row of icon buttons grouped by category (history | format | block | list | table).
- Buttons use egui::Button with a text glyph label (e.g. 'B', 'I', 'U', 'S', '`', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', '"', '</>', '—', '•', '1.', '☑', '→', '←', 'Table') as text until icon assets are available; do NOT block on icons.
- Active state (e.g. cursor inside bold text): button background changes to the egui selection color. Compute active state by inspecting marks at the cursor position in the DocModel.
- Overflow: if the toolbar width < total button width, render a '...' overflow button that opens an egui popup listing the remaining commands.
- AccessKit: each toolbar button gets author_id = format!('toolbar-btn-{}', command_id) with Role::Button and Actions::Click, integrating with the existing AccessKit surface in accessibility/ (mod.rs, registry.rs, live.rs).
- Command dispatch: route toolbar/keymap command activation through the existing command_registry.rs + event_bus.rs surfaces (shared command/event bus) rather than introducing a new ad-hoc dispatch channel.

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS (keymap.rs) - must match React editor_keymap.ts bindings:
- Ctrl+B -> toggle_bold
- Ctrl+I -> toggle_italic
- Ctrl+U -> toggle_underline
- Ctrl+Shift+X -> toggle_strike
- Ctrl+E -> toggle_code
- Ctrl+Z -> undo
- Ctrl+Shift+Z -> redo
- Ctrl+Shift+7 -> toggle_ordered_list
- Ctrl+Shift+8 -> toggle_bullet_list
- Tab (inside list) -> sink_list_item
- Shift+Tab (inside list) -> lift_list_item
- Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3 -> set_heading(1/2/3)
- Ctrl+Alt+0 -> set_paragraph
- Ctrl+Shift+B -> set_blockquote

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. In commands.rs, implement each command as a fn that builds a Transaction using the MT-011 Step variants. For toggle commands, check the current mark/node state first (active check) and flip.
2. For toggle_task_list, list items get an attrs field 'checked': false; toggle_task_item_checked sets it to true/false.
3. For table commands (add_row_after etc.), build InsertNode / DeleteNode Steps targeting the correct table_row / table_cell path in the DocModel.
4. In toolbar.rs, impl egui::Widget for EditorToolbar. For each command, egui::Button::new(label).selected(active).ui(ui): on click call the command fn.
5. In keymap.rs, a match on (egui::Modifiers, egui::Key) returns Option<FormattingCommand>; called from input_handler.rs before falling through to text insertion.
6. Extend rich_editor_widget.rs: place toolbar above the ScrollArea content area using ui.vertical(|ui| { toolbar.ui(ui); content_area(ui); }).
7. Write cargo tests: toggle_bold on a selection adds bold mark; toggle_bold again removes it. set_heading(2) changes node kind to Heading(2). insert_table(2,3) produces a table with 2 rows and 3 cols each. undo after toggle_bold restores the pre-bold state.

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (DocModel + Transaction + UndoManager), MT-012 (egui widget host and input_handler dispatch point).

SCOPE EXPANSION - CROSS-BLOCK STRUCTURAL EDITING (KERNEL_BUILDER gate 2026-06-22, operator-sanctioned 'expand scope if features are missing'): MT-012 deferred cross-block editing to 'MT-013 structural editing' but this contract only lists formatting/toolbar. A rich-text editor is unusable without it, so ADD the two core structural commands here (MT-013 owns the command layer + input_handler.rs): (a) Enter / InsertParagraphBreak -> MT-011 SplitNode at the caret (splits the current block into two; caret + Selection move to the start of the new block); (b) Backspace at caret offset 0 -> MT-011 MergeNodes (merge current block into the previous sibling; caret lands at the join point) - this closes MT-012's 'Backspace at offset 0 is a no-op' deferral. Both mutate the MODEL only (the MT-012 renderer re-renders the new tree; no block_renderer/caret.rs edit needed - set the post-op Selection in the command). Add a test: Enter splits a paragraph into two, Backspace-at-0 merges back, undo restores. Richer list-aware Enter (new list item / lift-out of empty item) may extend in a later E2 MT.

Add assert_no_local_artifact_dir() (guards test_output/ AND tests/screenshots/) to the toolbar screenshot test. A tracked PNG under src/ is a hygiene FAILURE (the pipeline now also fails the MT on `git ls-files src/**/*.png`).

BACKEND NODE-SHAPE ANCHOR (MT-011 hsLink lesson, KERNEL_BUILDER gate): list/table/task_item commands MUST produce the node/attr shapes the REAL backend content_json uses - read the app/src parity reference (editor_commands.ts + the Tiptap node defs, e.g. taskItem 'checked' attr, table/tableRow/tableCell + 'colspan'/'rowspan'/header attrs) so toggle_task_list/insert_table round-trip via MT-011 DocJson without UnknownNodeType. Do NOT guess attr names; anchor to the captured backend shape (the same way MT-011's hsLink/refKind fix did).

COMMAND DISPATCH REALITY (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): toolbar/keymap commands MUST work STANDALONE by calling the command fns directly on the local RichEditorState (doc/undo/selection) - the WP-011 command_registry/event_bus host Sender is NOT wired into the editor until E11/MT-069 (carried forward from MT-010), so routing through the bus is ADDITIVE/optional, never the only path. Active-state check iterates the FULL Selection range across all overlapping TextLeaf nodes (MC-001), set_heading guards context (MC-002), insert_table rejects nesting (MC-003). original_scope.summary:
Implement embed NodeViews for the four CKC media embed kinds (image, slideshow, album, video), porting the React embed asset resolution logic from app/src/lib/editor/embed_assets.ts and the hsLink NodeView rendering. Each embed kind is a BlockNode in the MT-011 DocModel with kind = EmbedNode, attrs = { embed_kind: String, ref_value: String }, and renders as an interactive egui widget inline in the document.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/asset_resolver.rs (async fetch of asset metadata + content URL from the real backend; mirrors embed_assets.ts logic)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/image_view.rs (single image renderer)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/slideshow_view.rs (ordered sequence of images with prev/next nav)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/album_view.rs (grid of images, click to enlarge)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/video_view.rs (video poster + play button; actual decode via OS media layer or a stub play button linking to the content URL)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/embeds/embed_block_renderer.rs (dispatch from EmbedNode attrs to the correct view)
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/renderer/block_renderer.rs to call embed_block_renderer for EmbedNode kind.

ASYNC ASSET RESOLUTION (asset_resolver.rs):
- Mirror the React embed_assets.ts validation pipeline EXACTLY (FAIL-CLOSED):
  - Reject empty ref_value -> EmbedError::EmptyRef
  - Reject absolute filesystem paths (drive letters, leading '/', UNC '\\') -> EmbedError::AbsolutePathRejected
  - Reject '..' or path separator chars in asset_id -> EmbedError::TraversalRejected
  - Reject http/https/file/javascript schemes -> EmbedError::SchemeRejected
  - For album/slideshow: ref_value is comma-separated asset_id list; validate each entry individually
- HTTP call: GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/assets/{asset_id} -> EmbedAssetMetadata
- HTTP call: GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/assets/{asset_id}/content -> raw bytes for image display
- HTTP call: GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/assets/{asset_id}/thumbnail -> thumbnail bytes
- Use reqwest (already in workspace) or the existing handshake_native::backend_client REST client (backend_client.rs); do NOT add a new HTTP crate.
- Resolution is async; use tokio::spawn in the egui event loop's async context or the shell's runtime. Cache resolved assets in a HashMap<String, EmbedResolutionState> keyed by asset_id so repeated renders do not re-fetch.

EMBED STATES (match React EmbedResolution):
- Resolving: show a spinner (egui::Spinner)
- Ok(asset, bytes): render the appropriate view
- Err(EmbedError): show a typed error chip (colored rounded rect with error kind text, never a blank) with author_id = 'embed-error-{asset_id}'

VIEW IMPLEMENTATIONS:
- image_view.rs: decode image bytes with the 'image' crate (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF); upload as egui::TextureHandle via ctx.load_texture(); render at aspect-correct width (max = available content width). Click opens full-size overlay.
- slideshow_view.rs: render one image at a time with prev/next arrow buttons; store current_index in view state. AccessKit: author_id = 'slideshow-{asset_id}', prev button = 'slideshow-prev-{asset_id}', next = 'slideshow-next-{asset_id}'.
- album_view.rs: render thumbnails in a wrapping grid (3 per row default). Click on a thumbnail opens a full-size modal (egui::Window). AccessKit: grid container = 'album-{ref_value}', each cell = 'album-cell-{asset_id}'.
- video_view.rs: render thumbnail with a play button overlay. On play click, open the content URL in the OS default player via open::that() (the 'open' crate) OR render a simple progress-bar placeholder with 'Video: {filename}' text. Mark this as a known limitation in code comments; full in-process video decode is deferred.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Add to handshake_native Cargo.toml (src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml): image = { version='0.25', features=['png','jpeg','webp','gif'] }, open = '5' (for video OS open).
2. Implement EmbedError enum and EmbedResolutionState in asset_resolver.rs. Write async fn resolve_embed(workspace_id, ref_value, embed_kind) -> EmbedResolution.
3. In embed_block_renderer.rs, match embed_kind to dispatch to the correct view fn. Pass the view state (HashMap per embed node, stored in RichEditorState).
4. In image_view.rs, cache the decoded TextureHandle in view state keyed by asset_id to avoid re-decoding every frame.
5. In block_renderer.rs (from MT-012), add a match arm for NodeKind::Embed that calls embed_block_renderer::render_embed(ui, node, embed_states, workspace_id).
6. Write cargo tests: asset_resolver validates and rejects absolute paths, traversal, empty refs (unit tests, no real HTTP). Integration test with a real backend: resolve a known asset_id and verify EmbedResolutionState::Ok is returned.
7. Assign AccessKit NodeIds and roles to all interactive embed controls as specified above (reuse the accessibility/ registry + snapshot facilities from WP-011).

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (EmbedNode kind in DocModel), MT-012 (block_renderer integration point). No dependency on MT-013 (formatting).

An EmbedNode with ref_value starting with 'http://' is rejected with EmbedError::SchemeRejected (unit test).

implementation_notes: The 'image' crate decode is CPU-heavy for large images. Decode on a tokio::spawn_blocking thread, then send the decoded RGBA bytes to the egui context via a channel/callback. Never decode on the egui UI thread.
egui TextureHandle must be created on the egui thread (ctx.load_texture); only the RGBA bytes travel across the thread boundary.
Album/slideshow ref_value is a comma-separated list of asset_ids (matching the React parseAssetRefList function in embed_assets.ts). Split on comma, trim whitespace, validate each entry individually.

The 'open' crate is used for video OS-level playback; this is an explicit known limitation documented in video_view.rs. In-process video decode requires a future MT with a media decoder crate (e.g. symphonia + ffmpeg bindings) and is out of scope here.

Asset resolution cache (HashMap<String, EmbedResolutionState>) must be stored in RichEditorState (owned by the shell frame, e.g. via app.rs / backend_client.rs runtime context), not inside the renderer functions, so it persists across frames.
Fail-closed: any EmbedError must render a VISIBLE typed chip. Never render blank space, never panic. This matches the React embed_assets.ts EmbedErrorKind contract.

Backend access goes through the existing WP-011 REST client handshake_native::backend_client (backend_client.rs); do not introduce a new HTTP client. Backend changes are forbidden; consume via API only.

Cross-WP dependency: this MT builds on the WP-011 native shell modules (accessibility/ registry+snapshot for AccessKit ids, backend_client.rs for REST access, app.rs for the shell frame/runtime context). These are delivered by WP-KERNEL-011 and are reuse targets, not depends_on edges within WP-KERNEL-012.

EMBED NODE-SHAPE RECONCILIATION (KERNEL_BUILDER gate 2026-06-22, MT-011 hsLink lesson - CRITICAL): do NOT assume/invent a NodeKind::Embed block with {embed_kind, ref_value} attrs - MT-011 NodeKind has NO Embed variant, and inventing one repeats the MT-011 wikilink-mark-vs-hsLink-node mistake. The React reference HsLinkView.tsx renders image/video/album/slideshow embeds AND wikilinks through the SAME hsLink node, so the backend almost certainly represents embeds as the EXISTING hsLink node discriminated by refKind (refKind in {wikilink, image, video, album, slideshow, ...}, refValue = asset_id or comma-list). FIRST verify against app/src/lib/tiptap/hs_link_node.ts + components/HsLinkView.tsx + lib/editor/embed_assets.ts (the real refKind values + refValue format). THEN render embeds from MT-011's EXISTING Child::HsLink atom, dispatching on refKind to image/slideshow/album/video views. ONLY if the captured real shape genuinely uses a separate embed node, add THAT exact node to MT-011's model (node.rs + doc_json, add to allowed_paths) anchored to the real shape - never an invented {embed_kind,ref_value} shape.

BACKEND PROOF REALITY (MT-008 pattern + Spec-Realism Gate): AC-1 (image renders) + the real-asset-resolve integration test need a LIVE Handshake-managed backend with a SEEDED asset (GET /workspaces/{id}/assets/{asset_id}+/content+/thumbnail). Prove the asset_resolver binding against the REAL backend if it can be started+seeded; gate the image-CONTENT ACs behind the integration Cargo feature + emit NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF if the asset cannot be seeded - do NOT fake the backend. The FAIL-CLOSED validation (empty/absolute/traversal/scheme rejection) + view logic (slideshow nav+wrap, album grid, typed error chips, resolution caching, decode-failure->error-chip) are FULLY unit-testable STANDALONE with mock resolution states + a counted mock fetcher - those must all pass with no backend.

VIDEO + HBR-QUIET (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): the `open` crate's open::that() launches an external OS app and STEALS FOCUS (HBR-QUIET violation - same reason MT-010 declined it). PREFER the poster/thumbnail + play-button + filename + content-URL-text PLACEHOLDER for video (NO `open` dep, no focus theft, in-process decode out of scope). OS-open via open::that() is OPTIONAL and ONLY on EXPLICIT user click + documented as a reviewed HBR-QUIET exception (user-initiated, never automatic); add the `open` dep ONLY if OS-open is actually implemented. Never auto-open on render.

CRATES + SCREENSHOT (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): the `image` crate (0.25) is ALREADY a runtime dep in the handshake-native Cargo.toml (MT-012 review confirmed) - do NOT re-add or duplicate it (reconcile the pre-existing double-declaration if touched). SCREENSHOTS mt014_image_embed.png + mt014_embed_error.png MUST go to the EXTERNAL ../../../../Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-test/wp-kernel-012-mt-014/ root via external_artifact_dir() + assert_no_local_artifact_dir() - NOT the repo-local tests/screenshots/ the contract names (pipeline fails the MT on git ls-files src/**/*.png). ACCESSKIT VARIANT: field-correct nearest accesskit 0.21.1 Role; ACs assert author_id. Decode off-thread (spawn_blocking, MC-001), album concurrency<=6 (Semaphore, MC-002), traversal '..' substring-anywhere reject (MC-003), decode-fail->Err chip (MC-005).

original_scope.summary:
Implement wikilinks, transclusion, and backlinks in the native rich-text editor, binding to the backend loom edge + knowledge document backlink APIs. This MT ports the React wikilink.ts parsing logic, the LoomTransclusionView component, and the backlinks panel from RichDocumentView.tsx.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/parser.rs (ports app/src/lib/editor/wikilink.ts)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/inline_view.rs (renders a Mark::Wikilink as a colored clickable chip inline in the paragraph)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/autocomplete.rs (as the operator types '[[', show a popup with loom block / document search results)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/transclusion_view.rs (renders a BlockNode::Transclusion as a read-through embedded block preview)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/wikilinks/backlinks_panel.rs (side panel listing all documents that link to the current document)
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/block_renderer.rs to call transclusion_view for TransclusionNode kind.
- Extend inline_view dispatch in renderer to paint wikilink marks as chips.
- Reuse the shared command/selection/clipboard bus from the existing WP-011 modules command_registry.rs + event_bus.rs to route wikilink autocomplete commands and editor events; reuse loom_graph.rs for any loom block reference resolution affordance, and command_palette.rs + command_registry.rs for the autocomplete trigger surface. Do NOT invent a shared interaction bus module; the real flat modules above provide it.

WIKILINK SYNTAX (parser.rs - port wikilink.ts):
- Regex: [[prefix:value]] or [[prefix:value|label]]
- Known prefixes (port WP009_WIKILINK_KIND_BY_PREFIX from extension_inventory.ts):
  'block' -> LoomBlock ref, 'doc' -> RichDocument ref, 'wp' -> WorkPacket ref, 'file' -> file ref, 'tag' -> tag ref
- Unknown prefix -> WikilinkKind::Unknown (not silently dropped; renders with a warning chip color)
- Parse fn: fn parse_wikilink(raw: &str) -> Option<ParsedWikilink> where ParsedWikilink { kind: WikilinkKind, ref_value: String, label: String, resolved: bool }
- Input handling: when the operator types '[[' in the editor, parser.rs sets an autocomplete_mode flag in RichEditorState; the autocomplete popup (autocomplete.rs) appears.

INLINE WIKILINK CHIP (inline_view.rs):
- Wikilink mark in the DocModel renders as a colored rounded-rect inline chip: text = label (or ref_value if no label), background = accent color from egui theme.
- Chip is clickable: on click, emit a WikilinkActivated event (stored in RichEditorState.pending_events: Vec<EditorEvent>) for the host shell to route to Loom or the document viewer.
- Unresolved/unknown wikilinks render with a warning-yellow background and a '?' prefix.
- AccessKit: each chip = author_id = format!('wikilink-chip-{ref_value_hash}'), Role::Link, Actions::Click.

AUTOCOMPLETE (autocomplete.rs):
- On '[['  keypress, open an egui popup below the caret.
- Query: call GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/loom/search?q={typed_text}&limit=10 (search API from LoomSearchV2Panel reference) or GET /knowledge/documents?q={typed_text}&limit=10 depending on the prefix hint.
- Display results as a selectable list (egui::SelectableLabel). Arrow keys move selection; Enter/Tab inserts the wikilink mark and closes the popup. Escape cancels.
- AccessKit: popup = author_id = 'wikilink-autocomplete', each result row = 'wikilink-result-{i}'.

TRANSCLUSION VIEW (transclusion_view.rs - port LoomTransclusionView):
- A TransclusionNode in the DocModel (kind = Transclusion, attrs = { block_id: String }) renders as a read-only embedded preview of the target LoomBlock.
- Async fetch: GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/loom/blocks/{block_id}/transclusion -> LoomBlockTransclusion (from api.ts: title, content_preview, content_type, last_updated).
- Render: rounded border rect, title in bold, content_preview as plain text truncated to 3 lines, 'Open block ->' link button.
- Error states: loading spinner, typed error chip for 404/network failure.
- AccessKit: container = 'transclusion-{block_id}', open button = 'transclusion-open-{block_id}'.

BACKLINKS PANEL (backlinks_panel.rs - port RichDocumentView.tsx backlinks section):
- Async fetch: GET /knowledge/documents/{document_id}/backlinks -> { source_document_id, backlinks: [{ source_doc_id, source_title, link_kind, ref_value, ... }] }
- Render as a collapsible egui::CollapsingHeader ('Backlinks (N)'). Each entry = clickable label (document title). Click emits BacklinkActivated event for the shell to navigate.
- Empty state: 'No backlinks yet.' text.
- AccessKit: panel = 'backlinks-panel', each entry = 'backlink-{source_doc_id}'.

BACKLINK CREATION (persistence):
- When a document containing wikilinks is saved (MT-020 calls saveRichDocument), the backend AUTOMATICALLY persists backlinks from the content_json (backend knowledge_document/backlinks.rs). No separate API call is needed from this MT; the wikilink marks in the DocJson output carry the ref_value that the backend indexes.
- Document this explicitly in backlinks_panel.rs as a code comment: 'Backlinks are written by the backend on save, not by this MT.'

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Port wikilink.ts WIKILINK_REGEX and classifyWikilink to Rust in parser.rs using the regex crate.
2. Add regex = '1' to src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml.
3. Implement inline rendering in src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/block_renderer.rs: when painting a TextLeaf, check for Wikilink marks; for each, compute the pixel span from cosmic-text glyph positions and paint a colored Rect with the label text on top.
4. In autocomplete.rs, detect the '[['  trigger in src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/input_handler.rs and set RichEditorState.wikilink_autocomplete = Some(AutocompleteState { query: String, results: Vec<WikilinkResult>, selected: usize }).
5. autocomplete.rs renders an egui popup window at the caret pixel position; async queries the search API.
6. On Enter in autocomplete: remove the '[['  text, insert a Wikilink mark via AddMark transaction.
7. Implement transclusion_view.rs and wire to BlockNode::Transclusion in src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/block_renderer.rs.
8. Implement backlinks_panel.rs and mount it in src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/rich_editor_widget.rs as a collapsible panel below the content area.
9. Cargo tests: parse_wikilink('[[block:BLK-001|My Note]]') returns kind=Block, ref_value='BLK-001', label='My Note'. parse_wikilink('[[unknown:xyz]]') returns kind=Unknown, resolved=false. Autocomplete state transitions (mock API).

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (Wikilink mark in Mark enum, Transclusion node kind), MT-012 (inline chip painting in block_renderer, caret pixel position for autocomplete popup).

implementation_notes: The wikilink chip painting must happen INSIDE the cosmic-text text run: pause the text rendering, paint the chip Rect at the glyph span coordinates, then continue rendering. Do not try to insert the chip into the text flow; overlay it on the exact glyph positions.
The autocomplete popup must be positioned at the caret pixel position (from caret.rs), not at the mouse position. This ensures it opens correctly even when using keyboard-only input.
Backlinks are fetched once when the document loads and refreshed only on explicit user action (a refresh button in the panel header) to avoid constant background polling.

The WikilinkActivated event is not handled inside this MT; it is placed in RichEditorState.pending_events for the parent shell (WP-011) to drain and route. Document the expected event shape in a comment in the event enum.
regex crate is already in most Rust projects; if not in src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml, add it. Use once_cell::sync::Lazy to compile the wikilink regex once.

AccessKit author_ids for chips, autocomplete popup, transclusion container, and backlinks panel must be registered through the existing WP-011 accessibility/ module (accessibility/mod.rs, accessibility/registry.rs, accessibility/live.rs, accessibility/snapshot.rs); do not stand up a separate accessibility layer.

Cross-WP dependency: the WikilinkActivated and BacklinkActivated events are drained and routed by the parent shell delivered in WP-011 (app.rs + event_bus.rs + command_registry.rs). This MT only enqueues events into RichEditorState.pending_events; routing is owned by WP-011 and is not implemented here.

The autocomplete search and any model-facing wikilink resolution affordances must surface through the existing MCP tool surface (mcp/mod.rs, mcp/tools.rs, mcp/action.rs) where parallel-model interaction is required; do not create a parallel command path outside command_registry.rs + event_bus.rs.

WIKILINK = hsLink NODE, NOT Mark::Wikilink (KERNEL_BUILDER gate 2026-06-22 - CRITICAL, MT-011 reconciliation): MT-011's harden REMOVED Mark::Wikilink and made wikilinks the Child::HsLink inline-atom NODE {ref_kind, ref_value, label, resolved}. This contract's 'Wikilink mark' / 'insert a Wikilink mark via AddMark' wording is the OLD shape MT-011 FIXED - OVERRIDE it. Render the inline chip from the EXISTING Child::HsLink atom (ref_kind in the wikilink family: wikilink/block/doc/wp/file/tag); autocomplete confirm REMOVES the '[[' text and INSERTS an HsLink atom via InsertNode (NOT AddMark); parse_wikilink('[[block:BLK-001|My Note]]') maps to HsLinkNode { ref_kind:'block', ref_value:'BLK-001', label:Some('My Note') }. Verify the prefix->ref_kind mapping against app/src/lib/editor/wikilink.ts (WP009_WIKILINK_KIND_BY_PREFIX) + hs_link_node.ts. The MT-014 media embeds already render from this same Child::HsLink by ref_kind - keep one unified hsLink dispatch.

TRANSCLUSION NODE SHAPE (KERNEL_BUILDER gate - same gap class as tableHeader/embed): MT-011 NodeKind has NO Transclusion variant. Before rendering, VERIFY against the real backend content_json + app/src components/LoomTransclusionView.tsx whether a block transclusion is (a) a SEPARATE node type, (b) an hsLink ref_kind variant (e.g. ref_kind='block' with a transclusion/embed display mode), or (c) a block node with a block_id attr. Render from the REAL captured shape. If a separate node is genuinely needed, ADD it to MT-011's model (node.rs NodeKind + doc_json json_to_block/block_to_json, now in allowed_paths) anchored to the captured backend shape - do NOT invent a {block_id} attrs shape that may not round-trip. Consider consolidating with the MT-016-carried tableHeader model addition.

BACKEND PROOF REALITY (MT-008/MT-014 pattern): transclusion fetch (GET /workspaces/{id}/loom/blocks/{id}/transclusion), backlinks (GET /knowledge/documents/{id}/backlinks), autocomplete search (loom/search or documents?q=) bind the REAL backend; gate the live-content ACs behind the integration feature + NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF if unseeded - do NOT fake. parse_wikilink + chip render + autocomplete STATE transitions + 150ms debounce (MC-002, assert 1 call for 5 keystrokes) + WikilinkKind::Unknown exhaustive (MC-005) + transclusion-404->Remove-embed chip (MC-003) + backlinks generation-counter cancel (MC-004) are ALL unit-testable STANDALONE with mocks - those must pass with no backend.

CHIP PAINTING + EVENTS (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): the inline wikilink chip overlays on MT-012's egui LayoutJob/Galley glyph positions (Galley row layout / pos_from_cursor), NOT cosmic-text (MT-012 did NOT use cosmic-text); the chip Y must be SCROLL-ADJUSTED (subtract scroll offset, MC-001). original_scope.summary:
Implement the slash command menu: when the operator types '/' at the start of a blank line or after whitespace, an egui popup menu appears listing all insertable block types, embed kinds, templates, and manual-insert commands. Selecting a command executes it via the MT-013 formatting commands or inserts the appropriate node. This is the primary keyboard-driven block-creation surface (Obsidian / Notion parity).

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/slash_commands/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/slash_commands/registry.rs (static catalog of all slash commands)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/slash_commands/menu.rs (egui popup widget)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/slash_commands/executor.rs (dispatches a selected SlashCommand to the correct MT-013/MT-014/MT-015 handler)
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/renderer/input_handler.rs to detect '/' trigger and open slash menu.

REUSE EXISTING WP-011 MODULES: the slash menu is a keyboard-driven command surface analogous to the existing command_palette.rs; reuse command_palette.rs + command_registry.rs patterns for fuzzy-filter/ranking and command dispatch shape, and reuse the accessibility/* helpers (accessibility/registry.rs, accessibility/snapshot.rs) for AccessKit author_id assignment. The embed-prompt modal follows the egui::Window dialog pattern already used by context_menu.rs / context_menu_surfaces.rs. Do not introduce a new command bus; route shared selection/command state through command_registry.rs + event_bus.rs.

SLASH COMMAND CATALOG (registry.rs) - must cover:
  BLOCKS: Paragraph, Heading 1/2/3, Bullet List, Ordered List, Task List, Blockquote, Code Block (prompts for language), Table (prompts for rows/cols), Horizontal Rule.
  EMBEDS: Image embed, Slideshow embed, Album embed, Video embed (each prompts for asset_id / ref_value).
  WIKILINKS: Insert Link ([[...]] wikilink - opens autocomplete from MT-015), Insert Transclusion.
  TEMPLATES: (extensible stub) 'Daily Note Template', 'Meeting Notes Template' - insert predefined DocJson snippets.
  MANUAL INSERT: any raw node JSON (advanced; for swarm agent use).

Each SlashCommand { id: &'static str, label: &'static str, description: &'static str, keywords: &'static [&'static str], category: SlashCategory, action: SlashAction } where SlashAction is an enum variant (SetBlock(NodeKind), InsertNode(fn() -> BlockNode), OpenEmbedPrompt(EmbedKind), OpenWikilinkAutocomplete, InsertTemplate(TemplateId)).

MENU WIDGET (menu.rs):
- Trigger: '/' typed at start of empty paragraph or after whitespace. The '/' character itself is kept in the text until the command is selected or Escape is pressed.
- Filter: as the operator continues typing after '/', filter the catalog by label/keywords (case-insensitive substring match).
- Render: egui popup window at caret position. Items grouped by SlashCategory. Each row: icon glyph (text placeholder) + label + description in smaller text. Up/Down arrows move selection; Enter executes; Escape cancels and leaves the '/' in the text.
- Fuzzy match: implement a simple 2-pass filter (exact prefix match ranked first, then substring match).
- AccessKit: popup = author_id = 'slash-menu', each item row = 'slash-item-{id}', Role::MenuItem, Actions::Click.
- Max 20 items shown; scrollable if more match.

EXECUTOR (executor.rs):
- Before executing, remove the '/' trigger text (and any typed filter text) from the DocModel via a DeleteText transaction.
- Then dispatch: SetBlock -> call MT-013 formatting::commands::set_block_kind; InsertNode -> build the node and issue an InsertNode transaction; OpenEmbedPrompt -> open a modal dialog (egui::Window) with an input field for ref_value then call MT-014 logic; OpenWikilinkAutocomplete -> activate MT-015 autocomplete state; InsertTemplate -> fetch the template DocJson snippet and insert its blocks.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Define SlashCommand structs and the static SLASH_COMMANDS slice in registry.rs.
2. In input_handler.rs, detect '/' keypress: check that the char immediately before the caret is whitespace or the paragraph is empty; if so, set RichEditorState.slash_menu = Some(SlashMenuState { filter: String::new(), selected: 0, items: SLASH_COMMANDS.to_vec() }).
3. While slash_menu is Some, subsequent printable keys append to filter and re-run the filter; Backspace that deletes the '/' closes the menu.
4. In menu.rs, render the popup with the filtered + ranked items.
5. On Enter/click, call executor::execute_slash_command(selected_command, doc, undo, selection).
6. Cargo tests: detect '/' trigger sets slash_menu; filter 'head' returns only Heading commands; Enter on 'Heading 1' sets block kind; Escape clears slash_menu.
7. Assign AccessKit ids to all menu items.

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (InsertNode/DeleteText transactions), MT-012 (caret position for popup), MT-013 (formatting commands for block type changes), MT-014 (embed insertion), MT-015 (wikilink autocomplete activation).

This is the native Rust port of the document metadata section in RichDocumentView.tsx (title, tags, project_ref, folder_ref, authority_label, owner_actor_kind/id, created_at, updated_at, doc_version, crdt state).

PROPERTIES DISPLAYED AND EDITABLE (from RichDocument struct in api.ts / backend knowledge_rich_documents table):
  EDITABLE:
  - title: String (single-line TextEdit; autosaves on blur or Enter via PUT /knowledge/documents/{id}/save with updated title + existing content_json)

  - folder_ref: Option<String> (text input)
  READ-ONLY:
  - rich_document_id: String (displayed as a monospace label; click copies to clipboard)
  - doc_version: u64 (displayed as '#version')
  - authority_label: String (badge: 'promoted' / 'draft')
  - owner_actor_kind: String + owner_actor_id: String
  - created_at: String (ISO date, displayed as local human-readable)
  - updated_at: String (ISO date, displayed as local human-readable, refreshed after each save)
  - crdt_document_id: Option<String> (displayed if present)
  - backlinks_count: usize (count fetched from /backlinks endpoint, displayed as '↑ N backlinks')

TAG EDITOR (tag_editor.rs):

Check api.ts: LoomBlockDerived.tags is Vec<String>. For knowledge documents, tags are stored in a separate metadata field or via a separate API call. original_scope.summary:
Implement document-wide find/replace across prose and embedded code blocks, achieving VS Code-class parity with the React FindReplacePanel (app/src/components/FindReplacePanel.tsx, MT-244). The panel opens via Ctrl+F (find) or Ctrl+H (find+replace), floats above the content, and highlights all matches in real time.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/find_replace/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/find_replace/scanner.rs (scans the DocModel tree for text matches across all TextLeafs and code_block content)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/find_replace/panel.rs (egui panel widget: find input, options toggles, match count, next/prev, replace input, replace-one, replace-all, close)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/find_replace/highlight_layer.rs (paints match highlight rects over the rendered content)
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/rich_editor_widget.rs to host the panel and highlight layer.
- Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/renderer/input_handler.rs to handle Ctrl+F and Ctrl+H shortcuts.
- REUSE the shared command/shortcut bus from command_registry.rs + event_bus.rs (WP-011) for registering Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H rather than inventing a new bus; AccessKit ids register through accessibility/* (WP-011).

SCANNER (scanner.rs - port find_replace.ts logic):
- FindQuery { pattern: String, case_sensitive: bool, whole_word: bool, is_regex: bool }
- fn scan(doc: &DocNode, query: &FindQuery) -> FindScanResult where FindScanResult { matches: Vec<FindMatch>, truncated: bool } capped at MAX_MATCHES = 1000 (matching React EMPTY_SCAN pattern).
- FindMatch { kind: MatchKind, node_path: Vec<usize>, char_start: usize, char_end: usize } where MatchKind = Prose | CodeBlock { block_index: usize }.
- Prose matches: iterate all TextLeaf ropes, collect char ranges where the pattern occurs. For whole_word, check that the chars before/after the match range are not word chars.
- Regex matches: use the regex crate; on invalid regex, return FindScanResult::invalid_regex(error_message).
- CodeBlock matches: scan the raw text content of code_block nodes (code_block stores text as a single rope in a TextLeaf).
- Each call to scan rebuilds the full match list (called on every document change while panel is open, mirroring React's 'recompute on every document change').

PANEL WIDGET (panel.rs - port FindReplacePanel.tsx):
- Layout: floating egui Window at top-right of the content area, non-blocking.
  Row 1 (find): [TextEdit: find input] [Aa toggle: case-sensitive] [W toggle: whole-word] [.* toggle: regex] [count: '3 of 17'] [prev ◄] [next ►] [close ✕]
  Row 2 (replace, only when with_replace=true): [TextEdit: replace input] [Replace] [Replace All]
- Keyboard: Enter = next match; Shift+Enter = prev match; Escape = close panel and return focus to editor.
- Match count display: '{current+1} of {total}' or '{total} matches' if no active selection; truncation marker '1000+ matches' when truncated.
- Regex error: inline red text below the find input (role=alert), matches cleared.
- Current match is highlighted differently (bright accent) vs other matches (dim highlight).
- AccessKit: panel = 'find-panel', find-input = 'find-input', replace-input = 'replace-input', count = 'find-count', next = 'find-next', prev = 'find-prev', case toggle = 'find-toggle-case', whole-word = 'find-toggle-word', regex = 'find-toggle-regex', error = 'find-error', replace-one = 'replace-one', replace-all = 'replace-all', close = 'find-close'.

HIGHLIGHT LAYER (highlight_layer.rs):
- After block_renderer paints the content, iterate FindScanResult.matches. For each match, resolve the char range to pixel rects using the cosmic-text glyph layout (same mechanism as wikilink chip painting in MT-015). Paint semi-transparent colored rects over the content.
- Current match: accent color at 60% opacity. Other matches: accent color at 25% opacity.
- Highlights update on every scan rebuild (i.e. every document change while panel is open).

REPLACE LOGIC:
- Replace One: find the current match's char range in its TextLeaf rope; issue a DeleteText + InsertText transaction pair as a SINGLE atomic Transaction (one undo step). Advance to the next match.
- Replace All: iterate all matches IN REVERSE order (to preserve char positions of earlier matches); issue one Transaction containing all replace steps.
- CodeBlock replace: the code_block text is stored as a rope in a TextLeaf; the same DeleteText/InsertText steps apply.

KEYBOARD INTEGRATION:
- Ctrl+F: open panel in find-only mode (with_replace=false); if already open, re-focus the find input.
- Ctrl+H: open panel in find+replace mode (with_replace=true).
- These shortcuts are added to keymap.rs from MT-013 (or handled in input_handler.rs if MT-013 is not yet present; this MT does not depend on MT-013).

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Implement scanner.rs with the FindQuery/FindScanResult/FindMatch types and the scan() fn.
2. Add regex = '1' to src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml (may already be present from MT-015).
3. Implement highlight_layer.rs. Wire into block_renderer.rs after content painting.
4. Implement panel.rs as a floating egui::Window. Store FindReplaceState in RichEditorState.
5. Extend input_handler.rs: on Ctrl+F, set find_replace = Some(FindReplaceState { with_replace: false, ... }). On Ctrl+H, with_replace: true.
6. On panel Escape or close button: clear find_replace, clear all highlights.
7. Cargo tests: scan() finds all occurrences of 'foo' in a multi-paragraph doc. Whole-word mode skips 'foobar'. Regex mode returns error message for invalid pattern. Replace-all replaces all occurrences in a single Transaction (undo restores all). Replace-one advances to next match.

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (DocModel tree traversal + Transaction for replace), MT-012 (highlight layer integration with block_renderer, glyph position resolution, floating window placement).

implementation_notes: The scanner must walk the DocModel tree recursively and collect char positions RELATIVE TO EACH TextLeaf ROPE, not absolute document positions. This is because replace operations target specific rope positions within a leaf.
Replace-all in reverse order: sort matches by (node_path descending, char_start descending) before applying; this ensures earlier matches are not invalidated by later replacements.
The highlight layer paints AFTER all block content is painted, so highlights appear on top of the text. Use painter.add(epaint::Shape::Rect) with a semi-transparent fill.

The panel must NOT steal keyboard focus from the editor content; egui::Window does not auto-steal focus. The find input is focused explicitly only when the panel opens (call ui.memory().request_focus(find_input_id)).
For code_block matches, the highlight is painted over the code_block egui widget's bounding rect region corresponding to the matched char range in the rope.

HIGHLIGHT POSITIONS = Galley, NOT cosmic-text (KERNEL_BUILDER gate 2026-06-22): the contract says resolve match char ranges via 'cosmic-text glyph layout' - but MT-012 uses egui LayoutJob + epaint Galley (NO cosmic-text), and MT-015's chip painting already uses Galley. Resolve match rects via the SAME Galley row layout / pos_from_cursor, scroll-adjusted, painted as semi-transparent epaint::Shape::Rect AFTER block content (current match accent ~60% / others ~25%). Module root is rich_editor/ NOT rich_text/ (real tree).

RUST REGEX IS LINEAR-TIME (KERNEL_BUILDER gate - corrects RISK-003/MC-003): the Rust `regex` crate is a finite-automaton engine with NO catastrophic backtracking (unlike PCRE/JS), so '(a+)+$' does NOT hang it. Do NOT add the MC-003 thread/channel timeout machinery for a non-existent backtracking risk - instead use regex::RegexBuilder::size_limit/dfa_size_limit (compile-time memory guard) + the MAX_MATCHES=1000 cap (matching the React EMPTY_SCAN). Invalid regex -> FindScanResult::invalid_regex(message) -> red 'find-error' + cleared highlights.

SCANNER IS PURE IN-MEMORY CPU, NO PERPETUAL SPINNER (KERNEL_BUILDER gate - MT-015 spinner-regression lesson): scan() walks the DocModel in-process (NO backend, NO tokio runtime needed) - run it SYNCHRONOUSLY (optionally spawn_blocking ONLY for very large >50ms docs). Any 'Scanning…' indicator must animate ONLY during a genuine in-flight off-thread scan, NEVER an idle auto-repainting Spinner (the find panel + highlight layer live in the shared rich_editor_widget.rs - an idle spinner would re-break test_embeds/test_formatting_toolbar/test_rich_editor_widget). The panel renders ONLY when open (Ctrl+F/Ctrl+H; default closed), so the common path adds no repaint.

REPLACE TRANSACTIONS (KERNEL_BUILDER gate): Replace operates on TextLeaf rope char ranges via MT-011 Step::DeleteText + Step::InsertText - these ARE proper undoable Steps (this is TEXT replace, NOT the inline-atom-insert gap carried to MT-020). Replace-One = ONE atomic Transaction (single Ctrl+Z) then advance. Replace-All = ONE Transaction with all steps sorted DESCENDING by (node_path, char_start) so earlier positions don't drift (MC-001). Panel must NOT steal editor keyboard focus - egui::Window doesn't auto-steal; request_focus the find-input ONLY on open (HBR-QUIET). Screenshots mt018_*.png to the EXTERNAL Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-test/wp-kernel-012-mt-018/ root + assert_no_local_artifact_dir(). original_scope.summary:
Implement the daily notes / journal surface: a dedicated egui panel that opens or creates today's daily note LoomBlock via the backend openDailyJournal API, renders it as a rich-text document (using the MT-012 renderer), and provides date navigation (prev/next day, calendar picker). This is the native Rust port of app/src/components/LoomDailyJournalPanel.tsx (MT-257).

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE:
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/daily_notes/mod.rs
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/daily_notes/journal_panel.rs (top-level egui panel widget)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/daily_notes/date_nav.rs (prev/next day buttons + current date display + calendar popup)
- src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_text/daily_notes/journal_store.rs (async load/save of the daily LoomBlock and its associated RichDocument)

BACKEND FLOW (port LoomDailyJournalPanel.tsx):
1. On mount (or date change): call PUT /workspaces/{workspace_id}/loom/journals/{journal_date} (openDailyJournal in api.ts). This idempotently creates or retrieves a LoomBlock of content_type = 'journal' for the given date. Returns LoomBlock { block_id, title, content_type='journal', ... }.
2. The LoomBlock for a journal entry may have an associated RichDocument (via the block's linked knowledge document). If the block has a document_ref, load the document via GET /knowledge/documents/{document_id}. If not, show the block title and a 'Start writing' prompt that creates a new RichDocument linked to the block.
3. The loaded RichDocument content is rendered by the MT-012 RichEditorWidget (pass the DocJson from the document's content_json field).
4. On save (Ctrl+S or auto-save on idle): call MT-020 save logic (PUT /knowledge/documents/{id}/save). Do NOT re-call openDailyJournal on save.

PANEL LAYOUT (journal_panel.rs):
- Header: [← prev day] [date display: 'Thursday, June 19, 2026'] [next day →] [calendar icon → opens date picker popup] [today button]
- Subtitle: 'Daily Note' in muted text, block_id badge on hover
- Content area: RichEditorWidget for the journal document (or 'Start writing...' placeholder if no document yet)
- Footer: last-saved timestamp ('Saved 2 min ago') + word count + character count

DATE NAVIGATION (date_nav.rs):
- Prev/next buttons: increment/decrement the current date by 1 day using chrono::NaiveDate arithmetic.
- Today button: jump to today's date (chrono::Local::today().naive_local()).
- Calendar picker: a simple month grid popup (render a 7-column egui grid of day numbers for the current month; click a day to navigate). Highlight today. Highlight the currently displayed date.
- AccessKit: prev = 'journal-prev-day', next = 'journal-next-day', today = 'journal-today', calendar = 'journal-calendar-toggle', date-display = 'journal-date-display'.

STATE MACHINE (journal_store.rs):
- States: Idle, Loading { date: NaiveDate, workspace_id: String }, Ready { date, block: LoomBlock, doc: Option<RichDocLoad>, editor_state: RichEditorState }, Error { date, kind: JournalErrorKind }.
- JournalErrorKind: OpenFailed(String), DocLoadFailed(String), SaveFailed(String).
- Transitions: mount/date_change -> Loading; on openDailyJournal success -> Ready (with doc load if document_ref present); on error -> Error state with typed message.
- Error state renders a typed error chip (not blank) with a 'Retry' button.

AUTO-SAVE:
- 3-second idle timer: after the last keypress, if the doc is dirty (edits since last save), trigger a save. Reset the timer on each keystroke.
- Implement via egui's ctx.request_repaint_after(Duration::from_secs(1)) and tracking last_edit_time in the panel state.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. In journal_store.rs, define JournalState enum and async fn load_journal(workspace_id, date) -> JournalLoadResult that calls openDailyJournal then optionally loadRichDocument.
2. In date_nav.rs, implement DateNavWidget with the prev/next/today/calendar buttons. Calendar renders a 7-column month grid using egui Grid.
3. In journal_panel.rs, mount date_nav at the top, then match on journal_store state to render: spinner, error chip, or RichEditorWidget.
4. Wire auto-save: track last_edit_time: Option<Instant>; on frame update, if dirty and elapsed > 3s, call the save fn.
5. Footer: compute word count by splitting the full document text on whitespace. Character count = total rope char count across all TextLeafs.
6. Cargo tests: state machine transitions correctly from Loading to Ready. Date navigation: prev from 2026-01-01 goes to 2025-12-31. Calendar grid renders 28-31 day cells. Auto-save timer fires after 3 seconds.
7. AccessKit ids on all controls.

CRATES: chrono already added in MT-017. No new crates required.

DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (DocModel for journal document content), MT-012 (RichEditorWidget as the content renderer). MT-020 (save logic) is invoked for auto-save; if MT-020 is not yet complete, stub the save call with a log message and mark save as pending in this MT's scope.

original_scope.summary:
Implement save-to-format export and draft/crash recovery for the native rich-text editor. This MT delivers: (1) a SaveManager that persists the document to the backend (the canonical authority), (2) export projections to HTML (self-contained and reference-linked), Markdown, plain text, and ProseMirror JSON, (3) draft/crash recovery via the backend draft endpoint so in-progress edits survive a crash or forced close, and (4) a conflict/merge UI for concurrent edits. This is the native Rust port of app/src/lib/editor/export_formats.ts + app/src/components/RichDocumentView.tsx save/draft/recovery logic (MT-244/MT-255). EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: - src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/mod.rs - src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/save_manager.rs (canonical save: PUT /knowledge/documents/{id}/save with optimistic concurrency) - src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/draft_manager.rs (draft upsert + draft recovery on mount) - src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/export.rs (export projections: HTML self-contained, HTML reference-linked, Markdown, plain text, ProseMirror JSON) - src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/save/conflict_ui.rs (egui conflict resolution panel: show diff, choose operator or server version, or merge) - Extend src/frontend/handshake_native/src/rich_editor/renderer/rich_editor_widget.rs to host the conflict UI and wire Ctrl+S. SAVE MANAGER (save_manager.rs - port RichDocumentView.tsx save flow): - fn save_document(doc_id: &str, content_json: &DocJson, expected_version: u64, ctx: &RichDocContext) -> Result - HTTP call: PUT /knowledge/documents/{doc_id}/save { content_json, expected_version, ... } - On 409 Conflict (version mismatch): transition to ConflictState { server_doc: RichDocLoad, local_content: DocJson }. Show conflict_ui. - On 200 Ok: update doc_version to result.document.doc_version, clear dirty flag, update updated_at. - SaveError variants: VersionConflict(RichDocLoad), Network(String), Server(u16, String), SchemaRejected(String). - Ctrl+S keyboard shortcut (SAVE_ACTION from editor_keymap.ts equivalent) calls save_document. DRAFT MANAGER (draft_manager.rs - port RichDocumentView.tsx draft flow): - On document mount: call GET /knowledge/documents/{id}/draft (loadRichDocumentDraft). If a draft exists and draft.base_doc_version matches the current doc_version AND the draft content differs from the server content: show a 'Draft recovery' banner with [Restore draft] [Discard] buttons. - On every document change (dirty): debounced 5-second upsert: PUT /knowledge/documents/{id}/draft { base_doc_version, base_content_sha256, content_json } (upsertRichDocumentDraft). - On successful canonical save: call DELETE /knowledge/documents/{id}/draft (clearRichDocumentDraft) to clean up. - On Discard draft: call clearRichDocumentDraft. - DraftState: None, Checking, Available { draft: RichDocumentDraft, shown: bool }, Discarded. - SHA256 of content_json: use the sha2 crate to compute base_content_sha256. EXPORT (export.rs - port export_formats.ts): - ExportFormat enum: HtmlSelfContained, HtmlReferenceLiked, Markdown, PlainText, ProseMirrorJson. - fn export_document(doc: &DocNode, format: ExportFormat, workspace_id: &str, title: &str) -> Result where ExportOutput { content: Vec, filename: String, mime: String }. - HTML Self-contained: walk the DocNode tree, emit HTML5 markup. For image embeds: fetch the asset bytes (GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/assets/{asset_id}/content) and base64-inline as data: URLs. Size guards (mirroring export_formats.ts): images up to 10 MB each; total base64 data cap 50 MB; video NEVER inlined. Unresolvable embeds: emit a visible

placeholder, never silent blank. - HTML Reference-linked: same structure but media elements use the backend asset content URL (http://127.0.0.1:37501/workspaces/{workspace_id}/assets/{asset_id}/content) instead of data: URLs. - Markdown: walk DocNode tree, emit CommonMark. Lossy (matches the React markdown export: drops underline/strikethrough nuance, flattens table col widths, converts wikilinks to [[kind:value]] tokens, converts task items to '- [ ]'/'- [x]'). Never panics on unsupported nodes; emit a '' comment. - PlainText: walk all TextLeafs and concatenate their rope content with newlines between blocks. - ProseMirrorJson: use MT-011 doc_json.rs serialization with a typed envelope { schema_version: 'rich_document_v1', projection_disclaimer: 'This is a read-only export projection. The canonical authority is the Postgres RichDocument record.', content: DocJson }. - File save: use the native OS file save dialog (rfd crate: rfd::FileDialog::new().save_file()) OR write to a specified path. On success, show a toast 'Exported to {filename}'. CONFLICT UI (conflict_ui.rs - port RichDocumentView.tsx conflict handling): - Floating egui::Window 'Save conflict'. - Show: 'Server version (v{N})' panel (read-only rendered block list) vs 'Your version' panel (current DocModel rendered). - Three choices: [Keep yours] (force-save with the operator's content at the server version), [Keep server] (reload server content, discard local), [Open merge] (open a side-by-side merge view, deferred to a future MT - for now show 'Merge not yet available' text). - AccessKit: window = 'conflict-dialog', keep-yours = 'conflict-keep-yours', keep-server = 'conflict-keep-server'. Register these via the existing WP-011 accessibility modules (src/frontend/handshake_native/src/accessibility/mod.rs + registry.rs); do not invent a new AccessKit registry. FILE SAVE DIALOG: - Add crate: rfd = '0.14' (Rust file dialog, async-capable, no wry/webview dependency). - Add crate: sha2 = '0.10'. - Add crate: base64 = '0.22'. STEP-BY-STEP: 1. Implement save_manager.rs with the save_document fn and the Ctrl+S wiring in rich_editor_widget.rs. 2. Implement draft_manager.rs: on mount call loadRichDocumentDraft; on dirty changes debounce upsertRichDocumentDraft; on save call clearRichDocumentDraft. 3. Implement export.rs: start with PlainText (simplest), then ProseMirrorJson, then Markdown, then HTML (both modes). Each export fn is independently callable. 4. Implement conflict_ui.rs: show when ConflictState is set. Wire Keep yours / Keep server buttons. 5. Add a menu button 'Export...' in the toolbar (toolbar.rs from MT-013 or as a standalone button if MT-013 is not yet done); for app-level menu integration reuse the existing WP-011 module src/frontend/handshake_native/src/top_menu_bar.rs. The button opens an export format picker popup. 6. Cargo tests: save_document 409 -> ConflictState set. Draft recovery: loadRichDocumentDraft returns a draft -> DraftState::Available. export_document PlainText extracts all text correctly. export_document Markdown produces valid CommonMark for a heading + paragraph + bold mark. SHA256 of DocJson matches base_content_sha256 in the draft upsert body. 7. Integration test (real backend): save, then save again with wrong expected_version, assert 409 -> ConflictState. DEPENDENCIES: MT-011 (DocJson serialization for save + export, doc_version tracking), MT-012 (Ctrl+S keyboard handling in input_handler.rs for the save shortcut).

implementation_notes: The HTML export must use a tree walker (recursive fn walk_node_to_html) that writes to a String buffer with proper HTML escaping (use the html-escape crate or manual entity encoding for &, <, >, ", '); NEVER use string concatenation of untrusted content.

For HTML self-contained, asset fetching is synchronous (blocking) within the export fn (called on a background thread via tokio::spawn_blocking when triggered from the toolbar). Do not block the egui UI thread.
expected_version for the save call MUST come from the RichEditorState.doc_version field (set on load and updated after each successful save). Never hardcode 0.

Draft upsert computes base_content_sha256 over the raw JSON bytes of the DocJson (serde_json::to_vec -> sha2::Sha256::digest). The exact same computation must be done in a cargo test to verify the value matches.

The rfd file save dialog is async; use rfd::AsyncFileDialog in the egui async context or spawn a std::thread for the dialog if egui is single-threaded. Do NOT block the frame loop waiting for the dialog.

Export format picker popup: a simple egui popup list with the 5 format options; clicking one runs the export and opens the file save dialog. This popup can be a minimal button group in this MT without full toolbar integration.
base64 encoding for HTML self-contained: use the base64 crate with the STANDARD engine. The data: URL format is: data:{mime};base64,{encoded_bytes}.

The Markdown exporter must handle ALL node kinds without panicking; for unsupported/future kinds, emit the comment placeholder and continue. A cargo test passes a document containing every supported node kind and produces non-empty output with no panics.
